en: Monochrome postcard-style print showing a medieval brick city gate and fortification. A round tower with a steep conical roof stands at the left, pierced by small slit windows. An arched gateway leads through the wall, with a couple of small human figures beneath it for scale. High, sloping ramparts or earthworks reinforce the walls on both sides. The scene is rendered in a somewhat artistic, etched style rather than a sharp photograph, and there is no visible caption on the front.
